articles.company_name: Net Lease Office Properties Common Shares of Beneficial Interest
articles.summary: Net Lease Office Properties (NYSE: NLOP) reported today that its Board of Trustees declared a special cash distribution of $1.50 per common share, totaling approximately $22 million. The distribution is payable on December 1, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 16, 2026. Including this distribution, NLOP has declared distributions totaling $24.19 per share since being spun off in November 2023. The following properties were recently sold for gross proceeds totaling approximately $34.4 million.
